verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing SaaS, so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only pricing, marketing features and a no-code integrations claim. Nothing mentions an API, an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, or a way to download one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
